responsibility: This generated implementation file is the dummy companion module for GNU Modula-2's ASCII definition. It contributes no executable runtime behavior beyond empty module init/fini hooks, but it anchors the exported set of ASCII control-character and formatting constants used throughout the mc-boot runtime, such as nul, nl, cr, tab, del, and aliases like EOL and eof.
same_name_distinction: Implementation-side dummy companion for GASCII.h: it repeats the ASCII constant macros only so the generated ASCII module has `_M2_ASCII_init`/`_M2_ASCII_fini` linkage, but defines no callable interface or additional behavior.
